development_device: Nothing Phone (3) / Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 / Nothing OS 4.1
notes: B126 is the current stable Beta 6. Major additions since Beta 5 include sample and loop import with waveform IN/OUT editing, rhythm-safe Slice Macro, Clouds-based Grain FX with routing and bypass, K09/T09 kick and tom models, independent Oneshot pitch/volume, per-lane Turing pattern shift, improved decay response and extensive audio/filter stability fixes.
